name: cooling_tower_water_air_sides
title: Cooling tower water and air sides (exercise)
summary: Teaching exercise: a direct-contact cooling tower closed on the water side and on the moist-air side, with the fictitious air capacity rate fixed by the specific-heat ratio and the air enthalpy balance.
